name: PGC 32873 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 32873, a compact elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc32873-hubble
story: PGC 32873 is a small, dense elliptical galaxy, a nearby analog of the massive, quiescent galaxies of the early universe. Hubble imaged it to help weigh the black hole at its center.

claims.text: PGC 32873 is in a sample of nearby compact elliptical galaxies imaged with HST in program 13050
Nearby compact elliptical galaxies are local analogs of the high-redshift massive, quiescent galaxy population and have high central stellar mass densities
PGC 32873 is a nearby early-type galaxy targeted by HST to measure its black hole mass
